senses.gloss:
utá, conj. and; also; even; connecting
words, clauses, and sentences; repeated:
uta…uta…(uta), both…and…(and);
at beg. of verse, 78^12; --uta vā: or even,
87^20; or, 84^14 (cf. atha, 6); apy uta, also.

uttamá, a.
 —1. up-most; highest; best,
esp. at end of cpds; excellent; chief;
 —2.
(out-most, i. e.) ut-most; extreme; last (see
67^6N.), 99^20. [úd, ‘up, out,’ 473.]

uttamagandhāḍhya, a. rich in excellent
odors, 15^19. [uttama-gandha +
āḍhya.]

uttamādhamamadhyama, a. highest
and lowest and midmost; best and worst
and middling. [uttama + adhama +
madhyama, 1257.]

uttaratás, adv. northward; to the north
of; w. gen. [1130], 105^13. [uttara.]

uttara-purastāt, adv. north-east of;
w. gen., 1130.

úttara-loman, a. having the hair above,
with the hairy side up.

uttarā-patha, n. the northerly way;
the north country.

úttareṇa, adv. northerly; north of, w.
acc. [1129], 102^5. [uttara, 1112c.]
